description: Angular component for managing a list of LWM2M attributes keys and values, including form handling, validation, and interaction with Angular forms and state management.

classes.name: Lwm2mAttributesKeyListComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing a list of attribute key-value pairs with validation and dynamic form controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes attribute names based on whether the component is resource-specific.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating changes to the form model.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided key-value map.

methods.name: attributesValueFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of attribute key-value controls.

methods.name: removeKeyVal
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair at specified index.

methods.name: addKeyVal
methods.description: Adds a new key-value pair to the form.

methods.name: createdFormGroup
methods.description: Creates a form group for a key-value pair, with validation.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with current form values.

methods.name: isDisabledAttributeName
methods.description: Checks if an attribute name is disabled based on usage.

methods.name: getFirstUnusedAttributesName
methods.description: Returns the first attribute name not yet used.

methods.name: updateUsedAttributesName
methods.description: Updates the list of used attribute names.

methods.name: isAddEnabled
methods.description: Determines if adding new key-value pairs is allowed.
